policy: External visual assets must be explicitly approved and have independently verified reuse terms before incorporation into distributed game builds.

candidates.name: SirMalo HGSS collection
candidates.notes: Verified public GitHub repository currently contains Buildings/ only (plus fused variants), despite README mentioning Nature/Urban. Rescaled 16px art to 32px for RPG Maker XP; original DeviantArt page blocks automated access, so artist's reuse terms remain unverified. Source is for comparison only.

candidates.name: Shady Forest Secondary
candidates.source_format: Gen 3 native 4bpp tiles + metatiles + palettes + attributes
candidates.notes: Actual Gen 3 insertable secondary tileset: tiles.4bpp, metatiles.bin, metatile_attributes.bin, palettes, example.png, tiles.png. README requests credit for all artists in credits.md and Rahtak for insertable reformat; multi-artist provenance requires review.
candidates.visual_review_notes: Strong atmospheric layered blue-green woodland and building detail; excellent forest reference, but not a coastal harbor.
candidates.repository_reuse_terms: Repository README states assets free to use and edit by default, with author-specific exceptions and required credits; verify folder README and individual author restrictions before import.
